CustomField.description: Rich text rendered on the confirmation (wrap-up) page after submission. Supports merge labels resolved against the Form Submission at runtime. A default message is seeded on new templates; ignored when Skip Confirmation Page is true.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Write the thank-you message users see after submitting (next steps, timelines, follow-up). Supports formatting and merge fields. A starter message is added automatically for new templates.
CustomField.label: Confirmation Page Message
